blocks.html: Build a gridded reference graphic (GRG) over a patch of map so everyone can call grid squares by the same letter/number.

slides.title: Open GRG Builder and start a grid
slides.html: Open the GRG Builder icon from the Additional Tools menu. The toolbar appears in the Action Bar. Pan and zoom to your area, then select the Grid icon.

slides.title: Set spacing and color, then place it
slides.html: In the Select Grid Spacing and Color window choose spacing, color, size and datum, then select Done to drop the grid. Long-press the center crosshair to move it; a short tap opens a radial with Enter Coordinate, MGRS Location or Delete.

slides.title: Add markers to the grid
slides.html: Select the Label icon to drop markers on the grid. Slide the marker pallet right and left for more marker choices.

slides.title: Export the GRG
slides.html: When the grid looks right, select the Export icon to process the imagery into a GRG (KMZ) file.

slides.title: Edit the GRG Capture
slides.html: The GRG Capture edit screen opens. Tick a feature's check box to remove it; tap the box itself to edit it. Drag the info box or point list to re-position them on the capture.

slides.title: Adjust the grid in Edit Grid
slides.html: Select Edit Grid to set Label Style (MGRS, Letter/Number or Both), grid color and spacing. Toggle Show Labels on or off, and Additional Labels to split the export across multiple image files or a multi-page PDF.

slides.title: Edit the point labels
slides.html: Select Point List to open Edit Point List. Set Text Color and Text Align (Left, Center, Right), and tap a point in the list to show or hide it on the capture.
